title: Cubic online HNF support transcript reuse
objective: Record exact HNF-changing support bits during eligible cubic relation collection and reuse them to eliminate the duplicate later tall relation HNF/support-selection pass while preserving authenticated transcripts and exact replay

oracles: Existing exact ordinary-object class-group certificate replay
Differential equality of authenticated relation transcripts before and after support reuse

handoff.summary: Eligible relation collection now records each exact prefix-HNF change and reuses that support history and final square HNF for quotient publication. The small-unit branch retains its tall-HNF path. C15 field 3.1.83062751.1 publishes the byte-identical 42-row transcript SHA256 b1282d038400684fb1c3116fe21e9ecddb7d20513b94a490ed6fd662c123d5e8, including 38 support rows and four tail rows, and passes independent exact conditional-GRH replay. Local ABBA prepared-fmpz timing on AMD EPYC7B13/Linux x64/Node26.8.1 measured old median 26.078325 ms versus new 23.854329 ms (1.093232x), using five warmups and eleven five-call samples per block, with separate pack processes and buffers prepared outside timing. Old source SHA256 ef3e29a26231ee956c3f8ecd9222ae152a43296cf2f292ba3af648d23fc4d0fb; new c7f2a53a4f2364dd54a34968efe72d52757b434765a9fce909d047c7eacc78c2. Reproduce with node bench/cubic-online-support-transcript.cjs OLD_ROOT NEW_ROOT against matching built production packs.
risks: Local shared-host timing excludes public dispatch, retries, buffer construction, and independent certificate replay; it is not controlled opt/PARI or corpus evidence.
The architectural gate reaches the known stale shared optimizer-opportunity manifest; shared manifest and receipt-policy refresh are integration-owned.
Focused native checks ran on Linux x64; other native and Wasm platforms still require integration CI. The full native suite was not rerun in this lane.
next_steps: Rebind shared source-policy and optimizer artifacts on the integrated source, then run broad architecture and native gates.
Run the authenticated 1000-field census, unseen neighboring fields, and controlled retained old/new timing on opt before claiming a broader performance frontier.
